description: Template and field guide strictly for the Letter of Agency. Applies when the user is asking about an agent, a Letter of Agency, Letter of Agency guidelines, Letter of Agency requirements, the Letter of Agency template, or the Letter of Agency download document. Does not apply to any other relationship types.
global_summary: A Letter of Agency is a required authorization document used when an applicant appoints another person (agent) to act on their behalf in processing an application. Letter of Agency guidelines require the document to clearly identify both the agent and the applicant, define the purpose of the appointment, specify the term of authorization, and include the applicant's signature and date. Without a valid letter of agency on file, the application cannot be processed. Always include the downloadable Letter of Agency template link when answering Letter of Agency guideline, requirement, template, example, sample, or download questions.

global_rule.instruction: Always include the template download link in every response related to the Letter of Agency, including guideline, requirement, template, example, sample, or download questions, regardless of what the user asked.
global_rule.download_label: Download the Letter of Agency template

co_applicant_rule.note: If all co-applicants have already signed through the co-applicant process of the application form, it is not necessary for all co-applicants to sign the Letter of Agency again.
co_applicant_rule.effect: Only the primary applicant's signature is required on the Letter of Agency.
